old: The bracket was too narrow, and the true answer lies outside it in the direction the search ran.
new: The bracket was too narrow; the answer lies beyond that edge.

old: That it equals the sum of the 36 monthly volumes divided by the mean month length, in stock tank barrels.
new: That it equals the sum of the 36 monthly volumes divided by the mean month length, reported in stock tank barrels at surface.

old: Each can be read directly from the build explorer panel, so the capstone tests navigation rather than arithmetic.
new: Each can be read directly from the build explorer panel without computing anything, so the capstone tests navigation rather than arithmetic.

old: Grep it for scripting and inclusion keywords, validate it, read the warnings, run the four comparisons, and recalibrate.
new: Grep it for scripting and inclusion keywords, validate it against the parser, read every warning it raises, run the four comparisons, and recalibrate the regional mean.

old: Read the RUNSPEC, check the grid against the map, check the fluid against the laboratory report, run it, read the results.
new: Read the RUNSPEC for dimensions and units, check the grid against the structure map, check the fluid against the laboratory report, run it, and read the results it writes.

old: Confirm the connection count is at least as large as the number of layers the interval spans at the well's position.
new: Confirm the connection count is at least as large as the number of layers the interval spans at the well's position, one completion per layer crossed.

old: Nothing changes but the keywords used, since WCONPROD with targets equal to the last observed rates is continuous.
new: Nothing changes but the keywords used, since WCONPROD with targets equal to the last observed rates makes the prediction a continuous extension.

old: Independent, and it would need the booking to have been produced by a second engineer working without access to the deck.
new: Independent, and it would need the booking to have been produced by a second engineer working from the raw logs without any access to the deck.

old: Grid modification and region assignment, since both can alter cell properties after the grid has been read.
new: Grid modification and region assignment, since both can alter cell properties and fluid assignments after the grid has been read.

old: Oil and water carry it, because both are metered at surface; gas is missing, because the ledger's gas is an allocation.
new: Oil and water carry it, because both are metered at the surface separator; gas is missing, because the ledger's gas figure is only an allocation.

old: All six sit exactly on cell centres, and the residuals of about 2.3e-13 m are the only departure from an exact recovery.
new: All six sit exactly on cell centres, so the kriged surface honours every mapped top, and the residuals of about 2.3e-13 m are the only departure from an exact recovery.

old: It is the shortest complete description of a reservoir model, so reading one is faster than reading the study document.
new: It is the shortest complete description of a reservoir model, so reading one is faster than reading the study document written around it.

old: The length of wellbore in the cell alone, which is why a longer connection always delivers proportionally more.
new: The length of wellbore in the cell alone, which is why a longer connection always delivers proportionally more regardless of the rock it crosses.

old: The target, since it is what the well produces for as long as the reservoir has oil to give.
new: The target, since a rate-controlled well delivers it for as long as the reservoir has oil to give and the floor only ever acts at abandonment.

old: The mode, since ORAT fixes which phase the limits apply to and the others are then unconstrained.
new: The mode, since ORAT fixes which phase the limits apply to, and the water and gas rates are then left entirely unconstrained by the block.

old: DATES, because TSTEP may not appear before the history has completed and a simulator refuses a deck that uses it early.
new: DATES, because TSTEP may not appear before the history has completed, and a simulator rejects any deck that uses it early with a keyword ordering error.

old: They coincide, which is why refining the report interval reduces the time-discretisation error of the solution.
new: They coincide one for one, so refining the report interval is how a modeller reduces the time-discretisation error of the solution.

old: It must fall within one layer thickness of the mean column top, which is what a gently dipping structure implies.
new: It must fall within one layer thickness of the mean column top, which is the relief a gently dipping structure with a modest closure implies.

old: It preserves the individual values of the middle layer and breaks the outer four, since the column is symmetric.
new: It preserves the individual value of the middle layer and breaks the outer four, since the column is symmetric about its central layer.

old: The deck's structure was calibrated against the booking, so its far-field shape carries no independent information.
new: The deck's structure was calibrated against the booking, so its far-field shape away from the wells carries no independent information.

old: Reading the deck strictly in the order a simulator reads it, rather than jumping to the block a question concerns.
new: Reading the deck strictly in the order a simulator parses it, section by section, rather than jumping to the block a question concerns.

old: Because a defaulted field raises an error in strict mode, so decks that use them cannot be validated.
new: Because a defaulted field raises an error when the deck is checked in strict mode, so any deck that uses one cannot pass validation and cannot be run.

old: Generated decks are correct by construction, so reading is only worthwhile for hand-written ones.
new: Generated decks are correct by construction, since the software enforces the format, so reading is only worthwhile for hand-written ones.

old: Associate covers the grid, Professional the fluids, Expert the schedule.
new: Associate covers the grid and its properties, Professional the fluids and rock tables, Expert the wells and the schedule that drives them.

old: Associate learns the format, Professional learns the simulator, Expert learns the solver.
new: Associate learns the keyword format, Professional learns how a particular simulator interprets it, Expert learns the numerical solver underneath.

old: The number of slashes, since each record needs one and the block needs a closing one.
new: The number of slashes, since each record needs one terminator and the block itself needs a closing one before the next keyword.

old: It delays it, because a coarse cell must fill completely before water passes to the next one.
new: It delays it, because a coarse cell must fill completely with water before any passes on to the next one.

old: Bubble point conditions, since that is where the three phases coexist and a single density set is unambiguous.
new: Bubble point conditions, since that is where the three phases coexist in equilibrium and a single density set is then unambiguous.

old: It appears as 400 either way, because solution gas is dimensionless and unaffected by the gas volume unit.
new: It appears as 400 either way, because solution gas is a dimensionless ratio and is unaffected by the choice of gas volume unit.

old: A well's reference depth moves when its completion changes, so a re-completion shifts its reported pressure history.
new: A well's reference depth moves with its completion, so a re-completion to a different layer shifts its whole reported pressure history onto a new datum.

old: It has an unusually detailed grid description, since the schedule includes the completions for every well in the model.
new: It has an unusually detailed grid description, since the schedule carries the completions for every well and each one repeats the cell indices it connects.

old: The gas-oil table has no measurement behind it, so nothing in the course is graded on its three parameters.
new: The gas-oil table has no measurement behind it, so nothing in the course is graded on its three fitted Corey parameters.

old: The naming rule and the completion strategy, since it adds a new well to the model that already exists.
new: The naming rule and the completion strategy, since the Expert tier adds a new well to the model that already exists.

old: One line each for the grid, the fluids, the wells and the schedule, matching the sections that carry data.
new: One line each for the grid, the fluids, the wells and the schedule, matching the four sections of the deck that carry explicit data.

old: One line each for the author, the date, the simulator version and the study the deck belongs to.
new: One line each for the author, the date, the simulator version and the study the deck belongs to, as a header block at the top of the file.

old: How many rows, what spacing, what range, what interpolation and whether the range covers the run's expected saturations.
new: How many rows, what saturation spacing, what endpoint range, what interpolation between rows, and whether the range covers the saturations the run is expected to reach.

old: The water salinity and the injection temperature, which decide whether scale or fines migration will damage the injectors.
new: The water salinity and the injection temperature, which decide whether scale deposition or fines migration will progressively damage the injectors' near-wellbore rock.

old: Every table the PROPS section will need, with the source and date of each recorded before any of them is written.
new: Every table the PROPS section will need, with the source and date of each recorded before any of them is written, so that a later reader can trace every curve.

old: Every cell property the grid will carry, with the averaging rule for each stated before the property model is upscaled.
new: Every cell property the grid will carry, with the averaging rule for each stated before the property model is upscaled from the geological grid to the flow grid.

old: The tier stops reading the deck and starts reading the results, which is where a study's conclusions actually live.
new: The tier stops reading the deck and starts reading the results, which is where a study's conclusions and its forecasts actually live.
